# Tropic NEEV

> Tropic NEEV is an affordable fashion discovery platform and student entrepreneurship project developed for NEEEV Startup Stormers.

## Website

https://tropic-neev.github.io/TropicNeev.com/

## About

Tropic NEEV combines social media marketing, e-commerce, and affiliate marketing to help customers discover trendy and affordable fashion products.

The core idea is:

FIND → CURATE → PROMOTE → SELL → ANALYZE → BUILD

Tropic NEEV does not simply list clothing products. It focuses on helping customers discover suitable fashion within their budget.

## Business Model

Tropic NEEV initially focuses on affiliate marketing and digital product discovery.

Potential revenue streams include:

- Affiliate marketing commissions
- E-commerce product margins
- Future Tropic NEEV branded products
- Future private-label fashion products

## Target Market

The platform is focused on customers looking for:

- Affordable clothing
- Trendy fashion
- Fashion discoveries
- Budget-friendly products
- Online fashion shopping

## Marketing

Tropic NEEV uses social media marketing to promote fashion discoveries and drive customers toward the website and relevant product platforms.

Key content areas include:

- Fashion trends
- Affordable outfit ideas
- Product discoveries
- Product showcases
- Short-form fashion content
- Customer engagement

## Website Technology

The website uses:

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- GitHub Pages
- GitHub Contents API
- Responsive web design

## Automatic Posts

The website automatically discovers fashion posts from numbered folders inside the `posts/` directory.

Example:

posts/1/
posts/2/
posts/3/

Only folders whose names consist entirely of numbers are treated as posts.

Only `.jpg` images are used for posts.

Images are sorted numerically by their filenames.

Example:

1.jpg
2.jpg
10.jpg

## Repository

GitHub repository:

https://github.com/tropic-neev/TropicNeev.com

## Project

Tropic NEEV is being developed as part of the NEEEV Startup Stormers entrepreneurship project.

The project focuses on:

- Problem identification
- Market research
- Customer validation
- Prototype/MVP development
- Business planning
- Financial planning
- Team collaboration
- Scalability

## USP

"We don't just sell clothes — we help customers find the right fashion within their budget."

## Future Direction

Potential future development includes expanding product categories, improving product recommendations, increasing social media reach, collecting customer feedback, developing direct e-commerce capabilities, and eventually creating Tropic NEEV branded or private-label fashion products.
